purpose: Run the first empirical full-suffix-versus-sliced branch-pair replay on the exact passing four-child RLM trace using the recorded structural message boundary and the authoritative changed suffix.

supersedes_failed_attempt.reason: The previous implementation maximized the exact common token suffix. That match extended 12 tokens backward across the recorded structural boundary, so its guard failed after one render request and before any sampled call.

scope.model_state: frozen base checkpoint; no optimizer or RL process

pairing_contract.intervention: Replace exactly one recorded recursive child action in the returning root's tool response.
pairing_contract.full_suffix: Visit every later policy event and resolve each action through the exact-key cache.
pairing_contract.sliced: Visit only graph descendants of the intervention and resolve each action through the same exact-key cache semantics.
pairing_contract.paired_generation: Generate each candidate action and changed returning-root action once, record them under exact prompt/checkpoint/decoding-config/seed keys, and fork that cache into both arms.
pairing_contract.request_serialization: Preserve insertion order in all nested prompt-bearing API objects. Canonical JSON remains reserved for signed reports and hashes.
pairing_contract.prompt_reconstruction: Fix the affected suffix length from the recorded structural message boundary: recorded prompt length minus exact recorded static-prefix length. Require the authoritative canonical render to end in that exact suffix, derive its canonical start from that fixed length, and require recorded-prefix plus canonical-suffix to reconstruct the original prompt bit for bit. Do not maximize the matching suffix. For every branch, require the canonical prefix before the selected boundary to remain unchanged, then combine the exact recorded static prefix with the authoritative changed suffix.
pairing_contract.candidate_seed_rule: SeedNamespace.action_seed under the frozen master seed, trace, target, and one-indexed alternative.
pairing_contract.continuation_seed_rule: SeedNamespace continuation seed at the returning-root structural address.
pairing_contract.reward: Exact stripped equality to the recorded terminal assistant content.

diagnostic_not_gate.same_prompt_same_seed_reproducibility: Report exact token equality for two pinned token-endpoint calls, but do not count a failure as sliced-versus-full disagreement.
diagnostic_not_gate.terminal_reward_rate: Report but do not require reward 1.0; the equivalence question is paired equality under identical interventions and continuation actions.
diagnostic_not_gate.canonical_whole_history_exact: Expected false because the trace preserves a noncanonical unchanged-history token boundary; decoded equality and exact lossless reconstruction are mandatory.

interpretation.pass: The recorded-trace replay adapter passes its representative live micro-gate and can be broadened under a separately frozen Stage-B campaign.
interpretation.fail: Stop and report without retrying or beginning training.
